# Painter Law Firm

> > Award-winning Texas medical malpractice law firm specializing in birth injuries, surgical errors, and diagnostic negligence with proven settlements and trial results.

Painter Law Firm is a specialized medical malpractice litigation practice based in Texas, led by experienced trial attorneys Robert and Taunya Painter. The firm handles complex medical negligence cases across multiple practice areas with a focus on birth injuries, brain injuries, and surgical complications.
